subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.-----INFO.DE.B.
description: Chart on book p. 63 (SD(SY)-41). VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; INFO-DE-B (information degrees) is the partner. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and TR-INFO (trans-information). From AFL-DY: ATTN (attraction). From TR-INFO: A-PR (all-purpose). From ATTN: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From A-PR: MT-INFO (multi-information). From CULT-AF-BS: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From MT-INFO: SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics).
